name: Rise and Be Recognized
label: Quest
description: Rise and Be Recognized: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is your time, friend. You have done much for the Frostwolf Clan and in doing so, earned a place as not only a soldier of Frostwolf but also as a friend.
Well done! Present your initiate's insignia.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This new insignia reflects your rank amongst the Frostwolf. Keep it on you at all times.
